scope: Immediate native queue acceptance, separate from handoff start
implementation: The existing controller emits a nonterminal progress observation after accepting one successor, retaining the root action identity and recording predecessor, checkpoint, accepted client tick/monotonic time, committed tick, lead ticks and queue depth. execution_started and terminal_eligible are false.

verification.positive: Three fixture handoffs each report acceptance with two ticks of lead and depth one, followed by their distinct native start observations.
verification.negative: Duplicate queue attempts emit no extra acceptance; no acceptance releases controls or changes root action identity.

limitations: Server validation of the new acceptance fields remains required before treating them as validated delivery evidence.
No HTTP-loss recovery fixture, live Minecraft latency measurement, route mount or packaged build.
Controller-fixture ticks are not ET6 capacity acceptance.
